interpretation_rule: A strategy is a versioned research template, not a trade recommendation or a claim of positive expectancy. It can advance only after frozen-rule, cost-aware, out-of-sample validation and independent risk approval.

strategies.name: ICT sweep and FVG research template
setup_rules: Detect an equal-high/low sweep from completed bars under the configured ATR tolerance.
Identify a completed three-bar FVG by the frozen definition.
confirmation_rules: Require an independently governed market/risk decision; correlated ICT/SMC/Price-Action structure counts once.
Require data quality, freshness policy, and point-in-time snapshot checks.
invalidation_rules: Close back through the sweep premise or the defined FVG/structure boundary.
Any missing/late/corrected input invalidates the research observation until rerun.
no_trade_conditions: No independent evidence group or no risk-approved levels.
strategies.example: Research-only: store a completed-bar sweep/FVG report before inspecting later outcome; compare against a non-ICT baseline.
strategies.common_failure: Double-counting sweep, FVG, BOS, and order-block labels derived from the same price path as independent confirmation.

strategies.name: Structure and zone-retest research template
setup_rules: Classify BOS/CHoCH/MSS candidate only from confirmed pivots and closed-bar break policy.
Construct zone/level with versioned displacement and touch tolerance.
confirmation_rules: Confirm zone state using a non-duplicative group such as documented volume semantics or a predeclared quantitative filter.
Pass independent risk sizing and minimum reward-to-risk rules.
invalidation_rules: Configured close through zone or level boundary.
Opposite confirmed structure sequence or changing rule/version.
no_trade_conditions: Volume semantics or session policy are unknown where used.
The evidence groups remain correlated only.
strategies.example: Research-only: evaluate a versioned S/R cluster after a completed BOS candidate, retaining all rejected candidates in the ledger.
strategies.common_failure: Calling a last-opposite candle a venue order block or treating a zone proxy as actual order-book supply/demand.

strategies.name: Wyckoff spring/upthrust research template
inputs: completed OHLCV with documented volume semantics
setup_rules: Detect range excursion then completed close back inside under declared tolerance.
Label only SPRING_CANDIDATE or UPTHRUST_CANDIDATE; do not back-label a full phase.
confirmation_rules: If volume is used, retain trade/tick-volume semantics and compare with a frozen trailing distribution.
Require independent risk and event gates.
invalidation_rules: Close beyond the failed range side under declared tolerance.
no_trade_conditions: No volume semantics for a volume-based confirmation.
Retrospective phase label is needed to justify the candidate.
strategies.example: Research-only: record spring candidate at bar close and evaluate a predefined horizon without changing the range after outcome.
strategies.common_failure: Presenting spring/upthrust vocabulary as confirmation of accumulation/distribution or as guaranteed reversal.

strategies.name: SMA/volatility baseline research template
setup_rules: Use frozen 20/50 moving-average direction after the declared volatility gate.
Calculate only with data closed at as_of.
confirmation_rules: Compare with simple baselines and evaluate temporal/OOS folds before any promotion.
Use risk limits rather than reward optimisation to size exposure.
invalidation_rules: Average cross or volatility threshold breach.
Any fold overlap, final-holdout tuning, or unrecorded trial invalidates the result.
no_trade_conditions: Costs, data lineage, or OOS comparison unavailable.
strategies.example: Research-only: log each parameter trial and its fold boundaries, including negative results, before selecting a baseline.
strategies.common_failure: Promoting an in-sample SMA result to an ML or live-alpha claim without multiple-testing and OOS controls.

strategies.name: High-impact event embargo control
setup_rules: Identify high-impact scheduled event inside the declared pre/post embargo window.
Set entry state to blocked; do not predict event direction.
confirmation_rules: Verify provider timestamp and lineage before lifting the embargo.
Apply post-event data-quality/freshness check before a separate analysis run.
invalidation_rules: Unknown/stale calendar means risk state is UNKNOWN, not safe.
An event revision or incorrect instrument mapping requires renewed review.
strategies.example: Research-only: retain embargo decision and calendar version alongside any rejected candidate signal.
strategies.common_failure: Treating the absence of a connected calendar as evidence that no event risk exists.
